Builddrone 0.4.0 is a security release. It fixes PowerShell command injection
in AppVeyor artifact uploads and prevents the archiver from following symlinks
into host files when building published zip archives.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/

---

## Security fixes

### AppVeyor artifact upload command injection

`appveyor.upload.artifact` no longer interpolates artifact paths into
double-quoted PowerShell strings. Paths and filenames are passed as
single-quoted literals, with embedded `'` characters escaped, so metacharacters
such as `"`, `$()`, and `;` cannot break out of the `Push-AppveyorArtifact`
arguments.

### Archiver symlink handling

The archiver now detects symlinks with `Path.is_symlink()` and skips them with
a warning instead of packing the symlink target into the zip. Folder walks also
use `followlinks=False`, so symlinked directories are not traversed.

This prevents contributor-planted symlinks under an archived folder from
including CI-host file contents in published artifacts.
